mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (current value below 3.0%) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0% at the decision time point.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in housing starts and retail sales exceeding 0.5% signal robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (INDPRO > 120 and rising), a further industrial production increase signals overheating and triggers monetary tightening expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO rises > 0.5% in 1 month and INDPRO > 120 at decision time.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.0% signals tightening monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 2100 thousand units signals robust housing demand, supporting economic growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above 2100 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.1 percentage points and nonfarm payrolls increase above 100k signal a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.1pp and PAYEMS rises > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls > 0.1pp and PAYEMS rises > 100k in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index above 120 signals robust economic output, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 120.
